lab_preparation.network: nftables table inet cp_set19_lab: outbound TCP/UDP 443 refused except loopback

rule: the driver calls only the Panel's HTTP API as the logged-in owner; every native fact is an SSH reading; owner actions and lab preparation on the guest are recorded as such; no certificate authority and no licence service is contacted by the driver

update.rule: the driver calls only the Panel's HTTP API as the logged-in owner; every native fact is a read-only SSH inspection; owner actions and lab preparation on the guest are recorded as such; no certificate authority and no licence service is contacted by the driver

update.does: registered lab identity, fresh guest (read-only; /etc/hosts is read, the resolver is never asked for celikpanel.net), host-side artifact and source proofs
update.name: preflight

update.does: fixture signing key; seal the candidate; guest-loopback celikpanel.net origin (provision + the enabled lab unit cp-lab-upd1-origin.service, which survives a restart) BEFORE the baseline; then celikpanel.net must resolve only to 127.0.0.1 and answer 200, so nothing reaches the real origin
update.name: origin

update.does: current_worker_baseline: real installer + unchanged trust enrollment (v0.1.0-alpha.90, commit 1743ac69edb0); the owner restart the installer may demand, then the origin is proved again
update.name: baseline-install

update.does: owner credentials (guest root only, host memory only), SSH loopback tunnel, pinned TLS leaf, POST /api/v1/auth/login, GET /api/v1/auth/me, GET /api/v1/panel/availability
update.name: owner-login

update.does: GET /api/v1/panel/license, POST {action:activate, acceptance fixture key} once, GET /api/v1/license/access
update.name: license

update.does: GET /api/v1/setup, PUT /api/v1/setup/guidance, PUT /api/v1/setup (draft, dns_mode external), POST /api/v1/setup/plan, POST /api/v1/setup/start (once), poll GET /api/v1/setup/operation?request_id= until succeeded/failed or a stable 120 s wait at ['access_dns', 'panel_certificate', 'verification', 'verify'] (recorded as observed) [purpose web_mail]
update.name: setup

update.does: POST /api/v1/domains/create {static}; POST /api/v1/domains/{id}/files?path=/index.html {action:write}; GET .../dns/zone, .../dns/records; GET .../mail/setup; POST .../mail/accounts; read-only cron availability, then POST .../cron only when crontab exists; GET /api/v1/firewall
update.name: seed

update.does: guest_probe observation (hashes, DB digests, timers), workload snapshot, offline shell fetch, sampler unit (5 s, survives reboot) + host loop (SSH, Panel via tunnel)
update.name: pre-state

update.does: read-only inspection before-check; origin proved again (127.0.0.1, HTTP 200); owner-update observer for the chosen request id: watch mode, no fault
update.name: arm

update.does: GET /api/v1/panel/update/check, GET /api/v1/host-mutation-readiness, POST /api/v1/panel/update/start {request_id, confirmed:true, current_version, current_commit, ...target} once
update.name: owner-start

update.does: GET /api/v1/panel/update/status?request_id= with UI backoff 1.5 s x1.6 <= 15 s; while the Panel is down: GET /api/v1/recovery/status?request_id= (same session), root CLI status --json/--lang en/--lang tr, offline shell reference; three-source agreement per sample; stops inconclusive after 600 s of an unchanged failed/none status with no recovery activity (settled-failed-before-change, H8)
update.name: track

update.does: only if the product reports paused_retry_limit: verify all views, run the exact one-time retry command printed in the recovery journal, once
update.name: owner-continuation (required)

update.does: installed/running identity, floor/foundation, DB digests vs pre-update, seeded rows, site marker, mailbox, cron, timers, firewall, Panel login and update card (rendered from the served build's systemUpdateOutcome.ts rules and catalogues, judged only on a real mismatch)
update.name: terminal

update.does: upd12, read-only: the Panel journal every 10 s until the last Panel process's bounded startup mail retry resolved (each deferred step completed or failed, or the give-up line) or 900 s; then once more after 45 s (nothing runs again); native mail file facts (size, mtime, SHA-256, postconf milters/SNI map) at the start and the end; the sampler keeps running
update.name: deferred-mail-watch

update.does: always once the guest was prepared, also after an early stop: sampler and host samples, journals (Panel/Agent/recovery, setup services, lab units incl. the fixture origin), observation records, observer/recovery-fault events, budget receipts
update.name: collect

update.does: per-workload outage windows (DNS: not-provided-external-dns), Panel window, agreement, outcome classification
update.name: verdicts
